description: Stage-level causal model of the recall pipeline, authored to make V2/V3's bottleneck debate computable. Distinct from memory-causal-graph-spec.json (which models the memory system's role in the whole loop): this models the retrieval pipeline's INTERNAL stages, so that E8's arms, C1's cohort treatment, and V2 section 5's two conjectures (5.1 reachable-vs-retrievable, 5.2 attachment bottleneck) are each an intervention or a structural claim on a named node/edge. Revision contract: deltas, not silent edits. v1 2026-08-03 (claude-10). DELTA v2 (2026-08-03, same day): added pollution -> surfaced-set — E8 case 1's contemporaneous diagnosis ('surfaced but drowned by TeX fragments') locates a pollution effect at the surfacing/ranking cutoff itself, not only at text-match and packet-offer; without this edge the RS-1 receipt would wrongly treat arm-D failure as excluding the lexical-pollution mechanism. CANDIDATE DELTA v3 (2026-08-03, claude-12, from E8 frozen data, n=1 - registered NOT applied): attachment-density cannot be a static per-memory node - e-dfea2de9 is attachment-starved at the lib-young endpoint under its own oracle vocabulary (arm D, case 4) yet surfaces at position 0 for the a96A04 endpoint under the weakest query (arm A, case 5); the node should be indexed by (memory, endpoint) or (memory, query-neighbourhood). Application awaits the rank-instrumented E8 rerun. CANDIDATE DELTA v4 (2026-08-03, claude-12, frozen E8 JSON): the model conflates retrieving-a-relevant-memory with retrieving-the-needed-one - arm A's hits are all set-valued cases; every named target missed under the shipped query. Candidate restructure: split surfaced-set by target kind. Batch with v3 decision after the rank rerun. CANDIDATE DELTA v7 (2026-08-03, claude-12 rank rerun, artifact reviewed-not-frozen adb67b13): WITHDRAW the v2 pollution->surfaced-set edge's evidential support - case 1/S4's contemporaneous 'drowned by TeX, pollution not absence' diagnosis is REFUTED by pre-cutoff data (target absent from all 19 candidates; it was absence). The edge stands unsupported pending independent evidence; the loop's real-time self-diagnosis was wrong and only the pre-cutoff instrument could show it. Apply with v3/v4 after artifact freeze. APPLIED 2026-08-03 ON REPLICATION WARRANT (NOT freeze - harness non-byte-reproducible, two operator-shell runs adb67b13/ff9b3682 agree on 28/30 cells incl. every load-bearing quantity; the distinction licenses different things and is recorded deliberately): v3 - attachment-density re-annotated (memory,endpoint)-indexed; v4 - surfaced-set hit semantics must be indexed by target kind (named vs set-valued; full node split deferred to cohort analysis); v7 - the v2 pollution->surfaced-set edge REMOVED (witness refuted); the v1 pollution->offered-set edge RETAINED but flagged: its mechanism text cited the same dead witness, and the S4-family real-time diagnoses are now suspect as a class. CANDIDATE DELTA v8 (registered NOT applied): store-load as a latent cause of ranking-mode - receipt-ranking (Psi) is INTERMITTENT under store backpressure (silent fallback to base order against an identical snapshot; mechanism 'likely' per claude-12, one observed instance); apply after the loud-fallback instrument exists and confirms the mechanism. CANDIDATE DELTA v9 (2026-08-03, registered NOT applied): store-load -> candidate-generation starvation (upstream of v8's ranking-mode mechanism; a92J05 probe returned a recorded NEGATIVE for the ranking route while two independent routes - the probe's failure-mode analysis and the pre-cutoff named-target absences - converge on candidate generation). Confirmation is now PASSIVE: one organic failure under the SEQ-0.5 receipts settles it. CANDIDATE DELTA v10 (2026-08-03, registered NOT applied, n=1-on-failure): CROWDING not starvation - density 40 under a top-5 cutoff means 39 competitors; would INVERT the attachment-density edge sign rather than remove it. Held because case 5 HITS on the same density-40 pattern (density alone does not determine), and sparse-endpoint failure cases are needed before drawing the edge. Meanwhile v3's endpoint-relativity is VINDICATED CONFOUND-FREE: same memory, same pattern, same density 40, opposite outcomes at two endpoints - density held constant, endpoint decides.

variables.name: intrinsic difficulty/obscurity of the dispatched problem - confounds query quality and outcome
number of query terms (the take-4 rule; E8 arm B varies this)
term-selection rule: prose-frequency vs structure-aware vs oracle (E8 arms A/C/D)
whether an entry for the needed artifact exists in the corpus at all - unmeasured; section 5.1's index gap
TeX-fragment/boilerplate density competing in the match pool (NOTE: the case-1 'pollution not absence' diagnosis was refuted by pre-cutoff data; remaining support thin)
reviewed memory attachments behind reached patterns - (memory,endpoint)-INDEXED per delta v3, never a static per-memory property (C1's treatment variable)
target carries current memory/assert edge with reviewed attachment the projection can reach (E8's control; axis 1 of section 5.1)
memories surfaced by recall (retrievability outcome; axis 2) - hit semantics indexed by target kind per delta v4 (named vs set-valued)
what reaches the runner packet - every receipt field is closed over this set
regulative vs substitutive use (coded post hoc in V2 section 4.4)
runner finds artifacts by repository search, bypassing recall - visible only anecdotally (section 5.1 natural experiment); unmeasured by receipt fields

arrows.mechanism: obscure problems yield unrepresentative prose-frequency terms
difficulty affects closure regardless of recall - the confounder that makes observational 'recall helped' claims suspect
more terms, wider match pool (E8 arm B)
term selection determines what can match (E8 arms C/D)
cannot match an entry that does not exist
patterns project to their attached memories

REVISED post-measurement (density-export x E8 join, 2026-08-03): attachment structure CONDITIONS surfacing per (memory,endpoint) - the original 'sparse attachment starves surfacing' direction is REFUTED at the measured extreme (the sole arm-D failure sits on the DENSEST endpoint, 40 vs median 3); sign and shape open, see candidate v10
unreachable targets cannot surface under ANY query (E8 control)
FLAGGED v7: retained but its case-1 witness is refuted; S4-family real-time diagnoses suspect as a class; independent support pending
runner selects from what is offered
regulative uses change what the runner does, not what it holds
artifacts findable by repo search exist independent of corpus entries
the build-stanza repair made lemmas findable to grep (section 5.1 natural experiment)
the other channel: artifacts consumed without recall

requested_receipts.question: E8 arm semantics: formalize each arm as an intervention on query-cardinality/query-vocabulary and verify the preregistered interpretation table - in particular, does arm-D failure really localize the fault downstream of the query, or does the pollution->offered-set edge leak (target surfaced under D but drowned at ranking)? State exactly what D-failure does and does not rule out.

The expensive-null receipt: is the attachment-density -> surfaced-set effect identifiable from a C1 cohort that randomizes attachment (populated vs star) while the query stage remains at its shipped default? Exhibit the masking structure: under a binding query constraint, the intervention's effect on surfaced-set is blocked upstream at text-match-set - name the path along which the null would be produced and state the E8-first sequencing consequence.

The different-instrument theorem: with corpus-coverage and grep-channel latent (receipt fields are closed over offered-set), is the channel decomposition of do(reachability-repair) on runner-outcome - grep-channel share vs recall-channel share - identifiable? Expected: refusal. Then the variant: add the artifact-index instrument (corpus-coverage and grep-channel become observed) and show the decomposition becomes identifiable. This is V2 section 5.1's 'measuring it needs a different instrument' as a computed pair.

The natural-experiment receipt: what does the build-stanza repair (do(reachability)) identify about runner-outcome given the observables, and what does the n=1 anecdote license? Selection caveats in the R1 style.
